items.source: wsHandler - the handler to process WebSocket messages; see PerConnectionWebSocketHandler for providing a handler with per-connection lifecycle.
items.translation: wsHandler - 用于处理 WebSocket 消息的处理器；有关提供具有每连接生命周期的处理器，请参见PerConnectionWebSocketHandler。

items.source: HandshakeFailureException - thrown when handshake processing failed to complete due to an internal, unrecoverable error, i.e. a server error as opposed to a failure to successfully negotiate the handshake.
items.translation: HandshakeFailureException - 当握手处理因内部不可恢复的错误而未能完成时抛出，即服务器错误，而非握手协商失败。

items.translation: 无论握手协商是否成功，响应状态、标头和主体都将被更新以反映协商的结果。

items.source: Contract for processing a WebSocket handshake request.
items.translation: 用于处理 WebSocket 握手请求的合约。

items.source: attributes - the attributes from the HTTP handshake to associate with the WebSocket session; the provided attributes are copied, the original map is not used.
items.translation: attributes - 要与 WebSocket 会话关联的来自 HTTP 握手的信息；提供的属性会被复制，不会使用原始映射。
